item.title: Time to Speak Some Dialects, Qwen-TTS!
item.description: Here we introduce the latest update of Qwen-TTS (qwen-tts-latest or qwen-tts-2025-05-22) through Qwen API . Trained on a large-scale dataset encompassing over millions of hours of speech, Qwen-TTS achieves human-level naturalness and expressiveness. Notably, Qwen-TTS automatically adjusts prosody, pacing, and emotional inflections in response to the input text. Notably, Qwen-TTS supports the generation of 3 Chinese dialects, including Pekingese, Shanghainese, and Sichuanese.

item.title: Qwen VLo: From "Understanding" the World to "Depicting" It
item.description: From the initial QwenVL to the latest Qwen2.5 VL, we have made progress in enhancing the model’s ability to understand image content. Today, we are excited to introduce a new model, Qwen VLo, a unified multimodal understanding and generation model.

item.title: Qwen3 Embedding: Advancing Text Embedding and Reranking Through Foundation Models
item.description: We release Qwen3 Embedding series, a new proprietary model of the Qwen model family. These models are specifically designed for text embedding, retrieval, and reranking tasks, built on the Qwen3 foundation model.

item.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
item.description: We are open-weighting two MoE models: Qwen3-235B-A22B, a large model with 235 billion total parameters and 22 billion activated parameters, and Qwen3-30B-A3B, a smaller MoE model with 30 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters. Additionally, six dense models are also open-weighted, including Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-1.7B, and Qwen3-0.6B, under Apache 2.0 license.

item.title: QVQ-Max: Think with Evidence
item.description: Today, we are officially releasing the first version of QVQ-Max, our visual reasoning model.

item.title: Qwen2.5 Omni: See, Hear, Talk, Write, Do It All!
item.description: We release Qwen2.5-Omni, the new flagship end-to-end multimodal model in the Qwen series.

item.title: Qwen2.5-VL-32B: Smarter and Lighter
item.description: Building on the Qwen2.5-VL series, we continued to optimize the model using reinforcement learning and open-sourced the new VL model with the beloved 32B parameter scale under the Apache 2.0 license — Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct.

item.title: QwQ-32B: Embracing the Power of Reinforcement Learning
item.description: We are excited to introduce QwQ-32B, a model with 32 billion parameters that achieves performance comparable to DeepSeek-R1, which boasts 671 billion parameters (with 37 billion activated).

item.title: <think>...</think> QwQ-Max-Preview
item.description: We’re happy to unveil QwQ-Max-Preview , the latest advancement in the Qwen series, designed to push the boundaries of deep reasoning and versatile problem-solving.

item.title: Qwen2.5-Max: Exploring the Intelligence of Large-scale MoE Model
item.description: Concurrently, we are developing Qwen2.5-Max, a large-scale MoE model that has been pretrained on over 20 trillion tokens and further post-trained with curated Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) methodologies.

item.title: Qwen2.5-1M: Deploy Your Own Qwen with Context Length up to 1M Tokens
item.description: Two months after upgrading Qwen2.5-Turbo to support context length up to one million tokens, we are back with the open-source Qwen2.5-1M models and the corresponding inference framework support.

item.title: Qwen2.5 VL! Qwen2.5 VL! Qwen2.5 VL!
item.description: We release Qwen2.5-VL, the new flagship vision-language model of Qwen and also a significant leap from the previous Qwen2-VL.

item.title: Global-batch load balance almost free lunch to improve your MoE LLM training
item.description: The Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) architecture has become a popular model-parameter-scale-up technique.

item.title: Towards Effective Process Supervision in Mathematical Reasoning
item.description: Today, we release a new state-of-the-art PRM that outperforms existing open-source alternatives for future research in building process supervision models.

item.title: QVQ: To See the World with Wisdom
item.description: Imagine an AI that can look at a complex physics problem, and methodically reason its way to a solution with the confidence of a master physicist. This vision inspired us to create QVQ - an open-weight model for multimodal reasoning, built upon Qwen2-VL-72B.

item.title: QwQ: Reflect Deeply on the Boundaries of the Unknown
item.description: What does it mean to think, to question, to understand? These are the deep waters that QwQ (Qwen with Questions) wades into.

item.title: Extending the Context Length to 1M Tokens!
item.description: After the release of Qwen2.5, we heard the community’s demand for processing longer contexts. In recent months, we have made many optimizations for the model capabilities and inference performance of extremely long context.

item.title: Qwen2.5-Coder Series: Powerful, Diverse, Practical.
item.description: Today, we are excited to open source the “Powerful”, “Diverse”, and “Practical” Qwen2.5-Coder series, dedicated to continuously promoting the development of Open CodeLLMs.

item.title: Qwen2.5: A Party of Foundation Models!
item.description: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. We are announcing what might be the largest opensource release in history! Let’s get the party started!

item.title: Qwen2.5-LLM: Extending the boundary of LLMs
item.description: In this blog, we delve into the details of our latest Qwen2.5 series language models.

item.title: Qwen2.5-Coder: Code More, Learn More!
item.description: Today, we are excited to announce the release of the next generation of open-source coding models, Qwen2.5-Coder, and officially rename CodeQwen to Qwen-Coder.

item.title: Qwen2.5-Math: The world's leading open-sourced mathematical LLMs
item.description: Today, we have upgraded it and open-sourced Qwen2.5-Math series, including base models Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B/72B, instruction-tuned models Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B/72B-Instruct, and mathematical reward model Qwen2.5-Math-RM-72B.

item.title: Qwen2-VL: To See the World More Clearly
item.description: After a year’s relentless efforts, today we are thrilled to release Qwen2-VL! Qwen2-VL is the latest version of the vision language models based on Qwen2 in the Qwen model familities.

item.title: Qwen2-Audio: Chat with Your Voice!
item.description: Today, we release Qwen2-Audio, the next version of Qwen-Audio, which is capable of accepting audio and text inputs and generating text outputs.

item.title: Introducing Qwen2-Math
item.description: Qwen2-Math is a series of specialized math language models built upon the Qwen2 LLMs, which significantly outperforms the mathematical capabilities of open-source models and even closed-source models (e.g., GPT-4o).

item.title: Hello Qwen2
item.description: After months of efforts, we are pleased to announce the evolution from Qwen1.5 to Qwen2.

item.title: Generalizing an LLM from 8k to 1M Context using Qwen-Agent
item.description: We’ve created an agent using Qwen2 models with an 8k context size to understand documents with 1M tokens, surpassing RAG and native long-context models.

item.title: Notes on Qwen-Max-0428
item.description: Previously, we opensourced a series of Qwen1.5 model ranging from 0.5 to 110 billion parameters. Now, we release a larger model, Qwen-Max-0428.
